title: Battle of New York
description: The newly assembled Avengers defend Manhattan against Loki and the Chitauri army, establishing Earth as a protected realm.

title: Civil War
description: Philosophical and personal division over the Sokovia Accords fractures Earth's mightiest heroes into opposing factions.

title: Battle of Titan
outcomes: Guardians and Stark stranded on Titan
description: Tony Stark, Peter Parker, and the Guardians ambushed Thanos on his ruined homeworld in a desperate attempt to strip his Gauntlet.

title: Thanos obtains the Infinity Stones
prerequisites: Thanos acquires Time Stone on Titan
outcomes: Mind Stone forcibly ripped from Vision
Infinity Gauntlet completed with all 6 stones
description: Thanos teleports to Wakanda, overpowers the defenders, reverses time to reconstruct Vision, and claims the final Mind Stone.

title: The Snap
outcomes: Fifty percent of all universal life disintegrates
description: Despite Thor striking Thanos in the chest with Stormbreaker, Thanos snaps his fingers, wiping out half of all life across the cosmos.

title: Avengers discover the Snap's Irreversibility on the Garden
prerequisites: Carol Danvers rescues Tony Stark and Nebula
description: The surviving Avengers track down Thanos only to discover he used the Stones to destroy the Stones, leaving Thor to decapitate him in despair.

title: Time Heist
prerequisites: Scott Lang returns from Quantum Realm
outcomes: Avengers travel to 2012 New York, 2013 Asgard, 2014 Morag/Vormir, 1970 Camp Lehigh
Natasha sacrifices her life for the Soul Stone
description: Utilizing Pym Particles and Tony Stark's temporal GPS, the Avengers travel through the Quantum Realm to borrow past Infinity Stones.

title: Avengers retrieve the Infinity Stones
outcomes: All six stones assembled into Stark's Nano Gauntlet
Bruce Banner volunteers to endure the Blip Snap
description: The stones are forged into the Nano Gauntlet. Smart Hulk harnesses the gamma radiation and successfully snaps everyone back.

title: Thanos attacks Avengers Compound
description: 2014 Thanos transverses the quantum tunnel in Sanctuary II, bombards the Avengers Compound, and prepares to rewrite the universe.

title: Battle of Earth
location: Ruins of Avengers Compound, Upstate New York
outcomes: Portals opened by Doctor Strange and Sorcerers
Sanctuary II destroyed by Captain Marvel
description: The resurrected Avengers, Wakandans, Sorcerers, and Ravagers join the line behind Captain America in the ultimate clash for universe survival.

title: Tony Stark performs the final Snap
location: Ruins of Avengers Compound, Upstate New York
outcomes: Thanos and his entire invasion force dusted into ash
Lethal cosmic radiation channels through Tony Stark's Mark 85 armor
description: Tony Stark wrests the Infinity Stones from Thanos via nanotechnology, uttering 'I am Iron Man' before snapping his fingers to save reality.

title: Tony Stark dies
location: Ruins of Avengers Compound, Upstate New York
outcomes: Tony Stark succumbs to fatal gamma radiation
Proof that Tony Stark has a heart lake memorial
description: Surrounded by Pepper, Peter, and Rhodey, Tony Stark passes away peacefully after being assured Earth is safe and he can rest.

title: Steve Rogers returns the Infinity Stones
location: Quantum Pad, Upstate New York / Multiversal Past
outcomes: Infinity Stones and Mjolnir restored to their exact origin timelines
Steve Rogers chooses to remain in 1949 with Peggy Carter
description: Steve Rogers departs via the Quantum Pad to return each Stone to prevent branched reality catastrophes, choosing a quiet life in the past.

title: Steve Rogers passes the shield to Sam Wilson
outcomes: Sam Wilson accepts the Captain America shield and mantle
description: An elderly Steve Rogers appears on a nearby park bench and bequeaths his iconic shield to Sam Wilson, blessing the next Captain America.
